title: Sharpen grumpy pass receipt v1
description: Written by a grumpy pass as its last step, under the gitignored <worktree>/.claude/grumpy/<branch>/receipts/<skill>.json. The sdlc gate chain records a skill gate only from a receipt naming a commit on the branch, and only while the report it names is still on disk unchanged. A record that the work ran, not a security boundary.

report.description: The pass's report file, relative to <worktree>/.claude/grumpy/<branch>/.

report_sha256.description: sha256 of that report when the receipt was written; links the receipt to the evidence, not a security boundary.
